assessment.nobel_worthiness: IceCube opened neutrino astronomy at high energies, establishing an entirely new observational channel for violent cosmic accelerators.
assessment.attribution: The named leaders plausibly represent the conception, construction, and scientific realization of the observatory, though the collaboration was necessarily broad.
assessment.maturity: The signal has been sustained and astrophysical associations have made the discovery convincing.
uncertainties: Allocating a three-person award fairly within a very large experimental collaboration requires careful review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Horizon-scale black-hole images are a landmark demonstration of global interferometry and a new means of testing strong-gravity astrophysics.
assessment.attribution: Doeleman, Falcke, and Zensus have credible central roles in the vision, organization, and radio-interferometric realization.
assessment.maturity: Images of more than one black hole and extensive consistency tests make this a mature experimental achievement.
uncertainties: The result depends on a large international array, so individual attribution must be scrutinized.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The direct discovery of the Higgs boson was a decisive experimental confirmation of the electroweak mechanism.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names are prominent ATLAS and CMS builders and leaders, but the discovery belongs fundamentally to two immense collaborations.
assessment.maturity: The particle's properties have been repeatedly measured and broadly agree with the Standard Model.
uncertainties: A previous prize recognized the theoretical mechanism; the appropriate experimental attribution and distinction require particular care.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Baryon acoustic oscillations provided a robust standard ruler and transformed precision measurements of cosmic expansion.
assessment.attribution: The named scientists made central theoretical and survey-analysis contributions, although the work rests on major survey collaborations.
assessment.maturity: Independent galaxy surveys have repeatedly used and confirmed the technique over two decades.
uncertainties: The boundary between the original demonstration, theoretical foundations, and subsequent survey leadership is not simple.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks unite exquisite control of atoms with extraordinary precision and have created a powerful new measurement capability.
assessment.attribution: Katori and Ye are clear principal pioneers of the lattice-clock concept and its experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: Independent laboratories have reached reproducible performance with major scientific and metrological consequences.
uncertainties: The eventual scope of fundamental discoveries enabled by these clocks is still developing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ground-based very-high-energy gamma-ray astronomy made the TeV sky a quantitative field and revealed extreme particle accelerators.
assessment.attribution: Aharonian and Hofmann are strongly associated with the scientific and instrumental advance, though multiple observatories contributed.
assessment.maturity: The technique and its astrophysical discoveries have been extensively replicated and expanded.
uncertainties: The field developed through several collaborations, complicating a sharply limited attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: SASE X-ray free-electron lasers created an exceptional probe of ultrafast structure and dynamics across science.
assessment.attribution: The three proposed names represent key theoretical, accelerator, and realization contributions to the breakthrough.
assessment.maturity: Operational facilities and a wide body of experiments demonstrate lasting impact.
uncertainties: Credit spans a long international accelerator-development history and needs detailed priority assessment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Silicon tracking detectors made precision vertexing and particle tracking central capabilities of modern collider experiments.
assessment.attribution: The nominees are important pioneers, but the development involved many laboratories, engineers, and experimental collaborations.
assessment.maturity: The technology is thoroughly established and has enabled major discoveries across particle physics.
uncertainties: It is difficult to isolate a single discovery-level advance and assign decisive credit among many contributors.
